# Researcher Harness

> Research methods, verification rules, templates, and shell tools for AI agents producing literature reviews, background briefings, perspective maps, and document reviews. Every number in an output traces through a claims ledger to a source file and the source's full text.

Clone the repo (https://github.com/baobab-tech/researcher-harness) so you can run the scripts; without a shell, read the files over HTTP and follow the method by hand. Read AGENTS.md first, then the SKILL.md for the task. Stop at every CHECKPOINT the skill names and ask the human; start with intent. Copy templates; do not write project files from memory. Paths are relative to https://raw.githubusercontent.com/baobab-tech/researcher-harness/main/

## Rules

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): source hierarchy, hard rules, evidence layers, working files, claims ledger, style
- [METHOD.md](METHOD.md): running a pass: audit, search, verify, prune, rebuild; subagent design

## Skills

- [resume](skills/resume/SKILL.md): session start; project state and what waits on the human
- [new-project](skills/new-project/SKILL.md): intent interview, then scaffold projects/<slug>/
- [background-research](skills/background-research/SKILL.md): orientation briefing on an unfamiliar topic
- [lit-review](skills/lit-review/SKILL.md): systematic literature review
- [scoping-review](skills/scoping-review/SKILL.md): map what evidence exists, without appraisal
- [rapid-review](skills/rapid-review/SKILL.md): systematic review with agreed, declared shortcuts
- [evidence-gap-map](skills/evidence-gap-map/SKILL.md): matrix of where evidence exists and where it does not
- [positions-map](skills/positions-map/SKILL.md): who argues what on a contested question, and on what evidence
- [policy-brief](skills/policy-brief/SKILL.md): problem, options, implementation for a decision-maker
- [source-review](skills/source-review/SKILL.md): critique or fact-check one document
- [sanity-check](skills/sanity-check/SKILL.md): the human spot-checks claims against sources
- [verify](skills/verify/SKILL.md): audit a project before sharing or updating

## Templates

- [brief](templates/brief.md), [source](templates/source.md), [claims](templates/claims.md), [notes](templates/notes.md), [checkpoint](templates/checkpoint.md), [sanity-check](templates/sanity-check.md), [index](templates/index.md), [log](templates/log.md), [queue](templates/queue.md), [project README](templates/project-readme.md)
- Outputs: [briefing](templates/outputs/briefing.md), [review](templates/outputs/review.md), [scoping-review](templates/outputs/scoping-review.md), [rapid-review](templates/outputs/rapid-review.md), [evidence-gap-map](templates/outputs/evidence-gap-map.md), [positions-map](templates/outputs/positions-map.md), [policy-brief](templates/outputs/policy-brief.md), [source-review](templates/outputs/source-review.md)

## Tools

- [scripts/keys.sh](scripts/keys.sh): run first; every key is optional
- [scripts/status.sh](scripts/status.sh): every project's state and what waits on the human
- [scripts/search.sh](scripts/search.sh), [scripts/doi.sh](scripts/doi.sh), [scripts/fetch.sh](scripts/fetch.sh), [scripts/check.sh](scripts/check.sh)
- [tools/search-providers.md](tools/search-providers.md): providers, free tiers, fallbacks when keys are missing
- [tools/verification.md](tools/verification.md): failure modes the rules prevent
- [tools/metadata.md](tools/metadata.md): Crossref, Unpaywall, Semantic Scholar; retrieval order around publisher blocks
- [tools/primary-sources.md](tools/primary-sources.md): PDFs, official series, organisational disclosures
